server_side_allowlist_validation.title: Server-Side Allow-List Validation
server_side_allowlist_validation.description: Untrusted input validated server-side at the trust boundary against an allow-list (anchored regex/length/charset + semantic business-range); fires is_false (absent/deny-list-only/client-side-only). Also the contributing input-validation control for SQL/NoSQL/LDAP injection.

validation_is_client_side_only.title: Validation Is Client-Side Only
validation_is_client_side_only.description: Only validation is client-side JS with no server-side counterpart; fires is_true (security-worthless).

denylist_filtering_used.title: Deny-List Filtering Used
denylist_filtering_used.description: Validation relies on a deny-list/blacklist instead of an allow-list; fires is_true (trivially bypassed).

parameterized_queries_used.title: Parameterized Queries Used
parameterized_queries_used.description: All DB access (SQL/NoSQL/LDAP/XPath) binds untrusted input via parameterized/prepared statements; fires is_false. Primary SQLi defense.

dynamic_query_string_concatenation.title: Dynamic Query String Concatenation
dynamic_query_string_concatenation.description: Untrusted input concatenated/interpolated into a query string; fires is_true (root cause of injection).

least_privilege_db_account.title: Least-Privilege DB Account
least_privilege_db_account.description: The app's DB account runs least-privilege (no DBA/admin; minimal verbs) so a successful injection is bounded; fires is_false. Distinct from least_privilege_access_enforced (DB-account grant scope, not general data access).

contextual_output_encoding_applied.title: Contextual Output Encoding Applied
contextual_output_encoding_applied.description: Untrusted data encoded for its exact output context (HTML/attr/JS/CSS/URL) via auto-escaping; fires is_false. Primary XSS defense.

unsafe_html_sinks_used.title: Unsafe HTML Sinks Used
unsafe_html_sinks_used.description: Untrusted data flows into unsafe sinks (innerHTML/eval/dangerouslySetInnerHTML) without DOMPurify; fires is_true.

content_security_policy_enforced.title: Content Security Policy Enforced
content_security_policy_enforced.description: Per-app CSP header set as XSS defense-in-depth; fires is_false (absent).

user_input_in_shell_command_string.title: User Input In Shell Command String
user_input_in_shell_command_string.description: Untrusted input concatenated into a shell command string (system/popen/shell=True/exec(String)); fires is_true.

os_commands_avoided_or_arg_array_used.title: OS Commands Avoided Or Arg-Array Used
os_commands_avoided_or_arg_array_used.description: OS ops use native library funcs, or argument-array spawn (no shell) with allow-listed command + validated args; fires is_false.

native_deserialization_of_untrusted_data.title: Native Deserialization Of Untrusted Data
native_deserialization_of_untrusted_data.description: App natively/binary-deserializes attacker-controlled input via an RCE sink (ObjectInputStream/pickle/unserialize/BinaryFormatter); fires is_true.

deserialization_class_allowlist_or_signe.title: Deserialization Class Allow-List Or Signed Payloads
deserialization_class_allowlist_or_signe.description: Where native deser is required, class allow-list/filter AND/OR signed-then-verified payloads constrain it; fires is_false.

xml_external_entities_disabled.title: XML External Entities Disabled
xml_external_entities_disabled.description: XML parser disallows DOCTYPE / external general+parameter entities; fires is_false (XXE).

entity_expansion_limits_enforced.title: Entity Expansion Limits Enforced
entity_expansion_limits_enforced.description: Parser bounds entity expansion (secure-processing/defusedxml) so nested entities can't exhaust memory/CPU; fires is_false (billion-laughs).

file_paths_canonicalized_and_contained.title: File Paths Canonicalized And Contained
file_paths_canonicalized_and_contained.description: User-controlled paths canonicalised + confined to an allow-listed base dir (or discarded for random names); fires is_false (path traversal/LFI).

outbound_fetch_destination_allowlisted.title: Outbound Fetch Destination Allow-Listed
outbound_fetch_destination_allowlisted.description: Server-side fetches from user URLs constrained by a scheme/host/port allow-list (redirects disabled/re-validated); fires is_false (SSRF).

private_and_metadata_targets_blocked.title: Private And Metadata Targets Blocked
private_and_metadata_targets_blocked.description: Fetches reject private (RFC1918), loopback, link-local, and cloud-metadata (169.254.169.254) targets; fires is_false (SSRF-to-metadata).

upload_extension_allowlist_and_magic_byt.title: Upload Extension Allow-List And Magic-Byte Validation
upload_extension_allowlist_and_magic_byt.description: Uploads validated by extension allow-list + magic-byte inspection (client Content-Type distrusted); fires is_false.

uploads_stored_nonexecutable_outside_web.title: Uploads Stored Non-Executable Outside Webroot
uploads_stored_nonexecutable_outside_web.description: Uploads stored outside the webroot in a non-executable directory; fires is_false (web-shell precondition).

uploads_randomly_renamed.title: Uploads Randomly Renamed
uploads_randomly_renamed.description: Uploads renamed to a random/UUID server-defined name (original discarded); fires is_false.

request_size_and_complexity_limits_enfor.title: Request Size And Complexity Limits Enforced
request_size_and_complexity_limits_enfor.description: Max request/field/upload sizes enforced before processing + bounded archive extraction; fires is_false (oversized-payload/decompression-bomb DoS).

redos_safe_regexes.title: ReDoS-Safe Regexes
redos_safe_regexes.description: Validation regexes over untrusted input are anchored with bounded quantifiers, no catastrophic-backtracking wildcards; fires is_false (ReDoS).

bindable_field_allowlist_enforced.title: Bindable Field Allow-List Enforced
bindable_field_allowlist_enforced.description: Request-to-object binding restricted to an allow-list of bindable fields (or via a DTO omitting sensitive fields); fires is_false (mass assignment / over-posting).
